hero.headline: Two Nations. One Shared Spirit.
hero.subheadline: From the shores of the Mediterranean to the pearl waters of the Arabian Gulf, Tunisia and Bahrain share a bond of family, hospitality, faith, sea and palm.
hero.welcome: Tunisia and Bahrain are separated by thousands of kilometres of sea and desert, yet their people greet each other with the same warmth. Both are Arab and Muslim nations with ancient roots: Tunisia is the land of Carthage, and Bahrain is the land of Dilmun. Both grew rich from the sea, both cherish the date palm, and both open their doors to guests with tea, coffee, dates and sweets. This website celebrates each country on its own, and the many things that connect them.
